pre_registration.name: shooting_luck_neutral_ratings
pre_registration.status: pre-registered 2026-10-08, after study 2 stopped (2021-26 still sealed), before any fit below
pre_registration.motivation: A team's 3-point and free-throw percentages, and above all its opponents' percentages, swing from game to game far more than true ability does (opponent 3P% and FT% are close to pure luck). The engine's ratings are built on points scored, so a team that has allowed hot or cold shooting carries that luck into its next forecast, and so may the opening line. A second set of ratings built on "shooting-neutral" points (each game re-scored with league-average 3P% and FT%, shot volumes kept) separates repeatable scoring from shooting luck; the model learns how much weight each deserves.
pre_registration.definition: pts_neutral = 2 x (FGM - 3PM) + 3 x 3PA x L3 + FTA x LFT, where L3 and LFT are the league's season-to-date 3P% and FT% up to the day before (previous season's rate until 5,000 attempts). Games without a box score keep their real points. Same DailyRatings settings as the engine. Features: x_pts_n = neutral points ratings total - opener; x_eff_n = neutral efficiency total - opener.

candidates.L1_shooting_neutral: locked v3 mean features + x_pts_n + x_eff_n (variance model, calibrator, products unchanged)

pre_registration.selection_rule: as study_2: lower log loss AND higher matched-volume ROI at -110 than the locked engine in BOTH eras
pre_registration.confirmation: as study_2: one run on the sealed 2021-26 seasons; lower log loss and matched ROI not lower at -110 and at the best real price
pre_registration.disclosure: Same 2021-26 history as study_2. Only one candidate, to keep the number of tests low.
